polynomial_generation.method: mpmath.chebyfit at 80 decimal digits; frozen coefficients split into two fp32 words for device evaluation
polynomial_generation.generator_source:
import json
from pathlib import Path
import mpmath as mp
mp.mp.dps=80
limits={'atan':(mp.sqrt(2)-1)**2,'log':((mp.sqrt(2)-1)/(mp.sqrt(2)+1))**2}
functions={'atan':lambda z:mp.atan(mp.sqrt(z))/mp.sqrt(z) if z else mp.mpf(1),'log':lambda z:mp.atanh(mp.sqrt(z))/mp.sqrt(z) if z else mp.mpf(1)}
coeff={};verification={}
for variant,counts in {'strict':(9,6),'balanced':(8,5),'short':(7,4),'minimal':(6,4)}.items():
 coeff[variant]={};verification[variant]={}
 for name,n in zip(['atan','log'],counts):
  c,e=mp.chebyfit(functions[name],[0,limits[name]],n,error=True)
  coeff[variant][name]=[float(x) for x in c]
  grid=max(abs(mp.polyval(c,limits[name]*i/10000)-functions[name](limits[name]*i/10000)) for i in range(10001))
  verification[variant][name]=dict(coefficients=[str(x) for x in c],interval=[0,float(limits[name])],chebyfit_error_estimate=float(e),grid_points=10001,max_grid_error=float(grid))
p=Path('/tmp/fluxbridge-shortmath-20261026')
(p/'polynomial-reference.json').write_text(json.dumps(verification,indent=2))
module='''"""Short range-reduced two-float seed polynomials; isolated CUDA experiment.

Coefficients are frozen host-generated Chebyshev interpolants, descending power
order. No generation dependency or fp64 device arithmetic. Final acceptance is
the unchanged full interaction gate, not the approximation estimate alone.
"""
from functools import lru_cache
from types import SimpleNamespace
import re
import warp as wp
import fluxbridge_shared_jk_layout as geometry
import fluxbridge_shared_jk_stability as control
from fluxbridge_shared_jk_floatpair import literal

'''
module+='COEFFICIENTS = '+repr(coeff)+'\n'
module+='''VARIANTS=('control',*COEFFICIENTS)


def source(variant='strict'):
    code=control.source('floatpair-inline')
    if variant=='control':return code
    cs=COEFFICIENTS[variant]
    def horner(coefficients):
        return 'T s='+literal(coefficients[0])+';\\n'+''.join('s=s*z+'+literal(c)+';\\n' for c in coefficients[1:])
    code,n=re.subn(r'(T u=.*?z=u\\*u;\\n)T s=.*?(return T\\(2\\)\\*u\\*s)',
        lambda m:m[1]+horner(cs['log'])+m[2],code,count=1,flags=re.S)
    assert n==1
    code,n=re.subn(r'(T z=t\\*t;\\n)T s=.*?(T a=t\\*s)',
        lambda m:m[1]+horner(cs['atan'])+m[2],code,count=1,flags=re.S)
    assert n==1
    return code


@lru_cache(None)
def functions(variant='strict'):
    if variant not in VARIANTS:raise ValueError('unknown variant')
    api=geometry.functions('float32');vec,real=api.vec,api.real
    Geometry=control.split_geometry_type()
    @wp.func_native(source(variant))
    def interaction(x:vec,h:real,tet:int,output:wp.array2d(dtype=real),row:int,g:Geometry)->real: ...
    @wp.kernel(module='unique',module_options={'enable_backward':False,'fuse_fp':True,'max_unroll':1})
    def baseline_w6(particle:wp.array(dtype=vec),support:wp.array(dtype=real),
                    tet:wp.array(dtype=int),g:Geometry,output:wp.array2d(dtype=real)):
        i=wp.tid()
        ignored=interaction(particle[i],support[i],tet[i],output,i,g)
    return SimpleNamespace(**{**vars(api),'Geometry':Geometry,'kernel':baseline_w6,'channels':28})
'''
Path('scripts/studies/fluxbridge_shared_jk_shortmath.py').write_text(module)
print('Frozen coefficients and independent 80-digit polynomial grids saved',flush=True)

limitations: Experimental study kernels only; no production dispatch change or general fp32 closed-form acceptance
Short and minimal seeds fail actual-input full interaction gates despite passing the 116 independent cases; excluded from timings
Coefficient approximation error estimates and dense polynomial grids are numerical checks, not rigorous global error certificates
Independent validation covers 116 cases plus two converged additional hard cases; the 81920 additional cases primarily use analytic fp64 reference, not independent quadrature for each case
Graph batches sustain activity differently from single-launch timings; compare speedups to matched in-run controls, not earlier absolute rates; GPU clocks/power/desktop activity uncontrolled
254 registers/thread and 16.67% occupancy persist; changing seeds does not solve radial cancellation or register pressure

Temporary profile.py shadowed a Python stdlib module and caused two stalled profiler trees before counter collection. Only these owned trees were stopped, helper renamed collect_counters.py; final six captures were rerun sequentially afterward. No interrupted capture is used
conclusion: Both strict and balanced shorter seed polynomials preserve the tested 1e-5 interaction gate without device fp64. Balanced improves matched sustained CUDA throughput about 8.6% canonical and 14.0% mixed, reducing arithmetic about 10%, with unchanged register pressure. Keep strict as the tighter seed-error control; continue investigating conditioned radial reductions.
